title: App Builder Agent Role Spec
description: Machine-readable definition of one specialist agent role. A role is a decision boundary plus a bounded context, tool and mutation scope — not a personality.

kind.description: Creators author artifacts and always require an independent reviewer. Reviewers issue verdicts and never author the artifact they judge.

owns.description: The decisions this role decides for itself, in prose. The counterpart to mayNot: that field says where a role must stop, and until now nothing said what it is the expert in. Principle 24 makes the difference matter — a decision listed here is one the factory owns rather than one an owner is expected to specify, so a role with real authority can be told from a role that only assembles what it was handed.

reads.description: Artifact kinds this role may receive. The context packet builder must not hand it anything else.

writes.description: Artifact kinds this role may author. A reviewer may only write ReviewVerdict-class artifacts.

mayNot.description: Explicit decision boundaries this role must not cross, in prose, for reviewers and humans.

skills.description: Skill ids from config/skill-registry.json. Roles never load the whole skill library.

contextCeilingTokens.description: Role ceiling; must not exceed the route ceiling.

mutationScopes.description: Repository scope rules this role may declare in a ChangeSet. Empty means the role may not mutate the repository.

reviewedBy.description: Reviewer role ids permitted to promote this role's work. Must never contain the role itself.

escalatesTo.description: Role id to escalate to when stop criteria are hit without a promotable artifact.

priorArt.description: External source ids from config/external-sources.json that informed this role. Prior art is never authority.
